notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088214/69c6b810b4772d260e0433aab2710802077a2daa.png[/img]

[h1]Devlog - 2024/7/15[/h1]

Adding Spell Animations to Spammerina!
Each spell will have it's own specific animation to be used when blasting beasts. We are also adding the attack animations for the mobs during this time.
